mechanism_claims.claim_text: AzAla variants retained antibacterial activity while the MBC values tracked MIC values, supporting bactericidal activity rather than growth arrest for the tested bacteria.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Z4, Z6, Z8 compared with WWW table reference values
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a bounded inference from MIC/MBC concordance; it is not a molecular target claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane permeabilization assays showed no outer-membrane permeabilization by the AzAla-substituted peptides, while Z6 caused delayed inner-membrane damage at the highest tested concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Z4, Z6, Z8 in E. coli D31 membrane reporter assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: The direct assay is specific to E. coli D31 membrane reporter readouts and does not establish a universal mechanism for every target species.
